entries.label: Tattoo 1

tags.subject: altar-throne crest with twin fish-creatures
tags.placement: front torso, spanning from the upper chest down through the navel

entries.description: A dense baroque altar-throne crest in heavy filigree, built around a tall central spire with paired arches sweeping out to either side and twin fish-or-fetus creatures curling at the base. Inked across the front torso, spanning from the upper chest down through the navel.

entries.label: Tattoo 2

tags.subject: mirrored arrow-shaped flower band
tags.placement: wrapping each upper arm as a sleeve band

entries.description: Two mirrored arrowhead-shaped bands of intricate openwork, each centered on a filled rosette flanked by leafy fronds tapering to a sharp point. Inked as a band wrapping each upper arm like a sleeve.

entries.label: Tattoo 3

tags.subject: mirrored floral rosette pendants
tags.style: fine line mandala with curling tendrils

entries.description: Two mirrored circular rosettes in fine line mandala work, each ringed by a wreath of petals around a small filled center, with a curling double-scroll tendril and a tiny secondary bloom dangling below like a pendant. One inked on each thigh.

entries.label: Tattoo 4

tags.subject: winged mandala bloom with twin spires
tags.style: bold mandala with feathered wing panels
tags.placement: upper back, descending from the nape between the shoulder blades

entries.description: A large layered mandala bloom anchored between the shoulder blades, flanked by two sweeping solid wing panels veined with fine line work, capped by twin slender spires that rise up the back of the neck. The piece is fully symmetric and dominates the upper back.

entries.label: Tattoo 5

tags.subject: mirrored hip florals with crescent moons
tags.placement: one on each outer thigh and hip flank

entries.description: Two mirrored swirling botanical compositions in openwork, each crowned by a solid filled orb and a small crescent moon above clustered five-petal blooms and curling vines. One inked on each outer hip, sweeping down onto the upper thigh.

entries.label: Tattoo 6

tags.subject: two-part botanical with upper-chest accent and belly leaves
tags.placement: two-part — small accent on the upper chest between the collarbones, with a larger leaf cluster around the navel

entries.description: A two-part botanical composition — a small upright feathered plume topped by a small triangle sits on the upper chest between the collarbones, while a larger pair of mirrored sprays of feathered leaves drapes across the lower belly anchored around the navel with a tiny diamond ornament at its center. Fine line work throughout.

entries.label: Tattoo 7

tags.subject: teardrop mandala with twin spires
tags.placement: upper back, descending from the nape between the shoulder blades

entries.description: A large teardrop-shaped mandala filled with concentric rings of intricate geometric line work around a central bloom, capped by twin slender spires that rise up the back of the neck. The piece is fully symmetric and dominates the upper back.

entries.label: Tattoo 8

tags.subject: butterfly-wing floral spray
tags.placement: upper chest, above the breast line

entries.description: A butterfly-like silhouette built from layered flower petals and leaves, with small dotted blossoms perched at each wingtip and a central upright plume. Inked small on the upper chest, just above the breast line.

entries.label: Tattoo 9

tags.subject: downward triangular mandala crest
tags.placement: front torso, spanning from below the breasts down through the navel to the lower abdomen

entries.description: A large downward-pointing triangular crest in bold filigree, built around a central blooming flower with scalloped lace edging along the sides and a small teardrop pendant hanging from the bottom point. Spans the full front belly from below the breasts down through the navel to the lower abdomen.

entries.label: Tattoo 10

tags.subject: wide tribal band with central crest
tags.placement: wide band across the upper chest, above the breast line

entries.description: A wide horizontal tribal band anchored by a leafy central crest with a small dotted halo above, feathered out with long sweeping symmetric flourishes to either side. Inked across the upper chest, above the breast line.

entries.label: Tattoo 11

tags.subject: vertical flame-feather plume
tags.placement: full spine column, descending from the nape down to between the buttocks

entries.description: A tall vertical plume of wispy flame-and-feather strokes, narrowing to fine tendril points at top and bottom around a small diamond-and-star ornament at the heart. Inked as a full spine column descending from the nape all the way down to between the buttocks.

entries.label: Tattoo 12

tags.subject: diamond-framed rose mandala back-piece
tags.style: ornate filigree pendant with lace edges

entries.description: An elongated diamond-shaped pendant framed in dense filigree with a dotted halo, holding a cluster of full roses in a solid filled inner panel at its heart and lace-like floral edging along its sides. Dominates the whole back as a single large piece.

entries.label: Tattoo 13

tags.subject: draped roses with hanging chains
tags.placement: upper-right chest above the breast, extending onto the right shoulder and upper arm

entries.description: A cluster of full-bloomed roses paired with a smaller butterfly silhouette, with looping jewelry chains draped beneath that gather into small teardrop pendants. Inked on the upper-right chest above the breast, spilling up over the right shoulder and onto the upper arm.

entries.label: Tattoo 14

tags.subject: stacked crown-and-lantern pendant column
tags.placement: full spine column, descending from the base of the neck down to between the buttocks

entries.description: A vertical stack of ornate ornaments — a small fleur-like crown at the top, a slender beaded chain mid-section, and a large lantern-like crown of arches and pearls anchored over the mid-back. Runs as a full spine column from the base of the neck down to between the buttocks.

entries.label: Tattoo 15

tags.subject: mirrored eye-shaped filigree medallions
tags.style: pointed oval filigree with open center
tags.placement: wrapping each upper arm as a sleeve

entries.description: Two mirrored pointed-oval medallions, each framing an empty almond-eye opening at the center with dense filigree petals and curling scrollwork flaring out from both tips. One inked wrapping each upper arm as a sleeve.

entries.label: Tattoo 16

tags.subject: coiled serpent
tags.placement: wrapping the right upper arm as a sleeve

entries.description: A naturalistic serpent rendered in fine scaled line work, its body knotted and looped over itself with the head raised and tongue flicking out. Inked wrapping the right upper arm as a sleeve.

entries.label: Tattoo 17

tags.subject: stylized open mouth with lash-like tendrils
tags.placement: lower abdomen, arched horizontally above the pubic mound

entries.description: A stylized open mouth-like motif arched horizontally, its curving upper and lower lips bristling with countless wiry hair-like tendrils along the edges like lashes or whiskers, and antenna-like tips flicking from each corner. Inked across the lower abdomen, the arch sitting just above the pubic mound.

entries.label: Tattoo 18

tags.subject: downward dagger crest with bird skulls
tags.placement: front torso, descending from the base of the neck down through the chest to below the navel

entries.description: A tall, narrow dagger-shaped crest descending the front torso, built from stacked gothic spurs and runic shapes around two beaked bird skulls flanking a central diamond eye at the base. Spans from the base of the neck down through the chest to below the navel.
